# Vize v0.13.1 - Table of Contents

> Elixir bindings for the Vize Vue.js toolchain — compile, lint, and format Vue SFCs via Rust NIFs.

## Pages

- [Vize](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Vize](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.md): Elixir bindings for the [Vize](https://vizejs.dev) Vue.js toolchain.
- [Vize.CSS](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.CSS.md): CSS parsing, printing, and AST traversal helpers.
- [Vize.CSS.URL](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.CSS.URL.md): A parser-backed CSS `url()` reference.
- [Vize.Croquis](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.Croquis.md): Semantic analysis summary for a Vue SFC.
- [Vize.Diagnostic](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.Diagnostic.md): Structured diagnostic emitted by Vize.
- [Vize.Native](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.Native.md)
- [Vize.Range](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.Range.md): A byte range in source text, using `[start, end)` offsets.
- [Vize.SourceLocation](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.SourceLocation.md): A source position reported by Vize.
- [Vize.SourceRange](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.SourceRange.md): A source span reported by Vize.
- [Vize.Vapor.Result](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.Vapor.Result.md): Result of Vapor template compilation.

- Exceptions
  - [Vize.Error](https://vize.hexdocs.pm/Vize.Error.md): Exception returned or raised by Vize bang APIs.
